analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive trading days. RSI at 70.7 entering overbought territory, MACD histogram at 656.9764 continues strong uptrend. Weekly ADX at 27.0 confirms a clear trend, but short-term overbought conditions on the daily chart suggest potential for pullback rather than further gains. Positioned at 41.0% of the 52-week high indicates upside potential, but short-term overheating warrants caution regarding potential corrections.
